platform: Apple M4 Pro, macOS arm64, one thread

method.input: Equal prepared RowData/Arrow, all signed widths, signed extrema, periodic NULLs and released epoch boundaries. The epoch-millis fixture corpus is shared by stock, current native and actual previous encoder.
expressions: YEAR(TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(v,CASE WHEN v<CAST(0 AS $TYPE) THEN 0 ELSE 3 END))
TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(v,CASE WHEN v<CAST(0 AS $TYPE) THEN CAST(NULL AS INT) ELSE 3 END) IS NULL
method.native_timer: Production Calc and equivalent output consumption inside Rust after import/before export. Setup and perimeter transposes alone excluded; intrinsic allocation/conversions/callbacks remain timed.
method.previous: Actual preceding encoder compiled on the same current DSO/executable, input fixture and allocator. Its generated temporal evaluator and positive consumed work remain; no synthetic callback is added.
method.pipeline: Eight million-row INT/BIGINT row-source/blackhole configurations, both shapes and both releases. Two warmups/five measurements, alternating engine order. Startup, JNI and both transposes remain.
